title: Gatebreakers Guild
brief: Place spike traps, barricades and bolt towers, then fight orc waves together to protect the portal.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: The Guild Gate
chapters.story: Pip opens the guild workshop just as the first gate fractures. Bora needs traps that survive more than a demonstration.

chapters.title: Two Roads to Trouble
chapters.story: Two roads bring two waves. Tess asks the guild to trade isolated heroics for a planned defense.

chapters.title: The Breach
chapters.story: The breach will seal only if the portal stands through the last assault.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
